package internalapi

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type hybridApplicationCapture struct {
	calls int
	err   error
}

func (c *hybridApplicationCapture) Apply(_ context.Context, _ string, _ string, p domain.HybridConsequence) (domain.HybridApplicationReceipt, error) {
	c.calls++
	return domain.HybridApplicationReceipt{ConsequenceID: p.ConsequenceID, LearningPathID: p.LearningPathID, Status: domain.HybridApplicationNoChange}, c.err
}
func hybridHTTPConsequence() domain.HybridConsequence {
	sid, pid := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	ref := "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64)
	scope := domain.HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: "go.backend", DirectionCode: "backend", DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}}
	return domain.HybridConsequence{Schema: domain.HybridConsequenceSchema, ConsequenceID: domain.HybridConsequenceID(sid, pid, ref, domain.HybridReplanPolicyVersion), StudentID: sid, LearningPathID: pid, ExpectedPathRevision: 3, SnapshotRef: ref, SnapshotTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.values", Version: "1"}}, PolicyVersion: domain.HybridReplanPolicyVersion, PolicyInputHash: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64), Outcome: domain.HybridOutcomeNoChange, ReasonCodes: []string{"NO_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE"}, BaselineScope: scope, DesiredScope: scope, Mutations: []domain.HybridFutureMutation{}}
}
func TestHybridApplicationPlannerOnlyAndStrictMalformedPrivacy(t *testing.T) {
	c := hybridHTTPConsequence()
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(c)
	url := "/v1/students/" + c.StudentID + "/learning-paths/" + c.LearningPathID + "/hybrid-consequences"
	for _, token := range []string{"planner", "general", "teacher", ""} {
		t.Run(token, func(t *testing.T) {
			capture := &hybridApplicationCapture{}
			router := NewRouter(&Handler{HybridApplication: capture}, "general", "planner", "teacher")
			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, url, strings.NewReader(string(raw)))
			req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
			w := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(w, req)
			if token == "planner" {
				if w.Code != 200 || capture.calls != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("plannerstatus%d", w.Code)
				}
			} else if w.Code != http.StatusForbidden || capture.calls != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("wrong token admitted status%d calls%d", w.Code, capture.calls)
			}
		})
	}
	var fields map[string]any
	json.Unmarshal(raw, &fields)
	cases := map[string]string{"duplicate": `{"schema":"x",` + string(raw[1:]), "case": strings.Replace(string(raw), `"schema":`, `"Schema":`, 1), "trailing": string(raw) + ` {}`, "private": strings.Replace(string(raw), `"schema":`, `"raw_evidence":"PRIVATE_CANARY","schema":`, 1), "null": strings.Replace(string(raw), `"mutations":[]`, `"mutations":null`, 1), "nested duplicate": strings.Replace(string(raw), `"goal_code":"go.backend"`, `"goal_code":"go.backend","goal_code":"go.backend"`, 1), "oversized": strings.Repeat(" ", domain.MaximumPlanningSnapshotRequestBytes+1)}
	delete(fields, "expected_path_revision")
	missing, _ := json.Marshal(fields)
	cases["missing"] = string(missing)
	for name, body := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			capture := &hybridApplicationCapture{}
			router := NewRouter(&Handler{HybridApplication: capture}, "general", "planner", "teacher")
			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, url, strings.NewReader(body))
			req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner")
			w := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(w, req)
			if w.Code != 400 || capture.calls != 0 || strings.Contains(w.Body.String(), "PRIVATE_CANARY") {
				t.Fatalf("malformed admitted status%d calls%d body%s", w.Code, capture.calls, w.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestHybridApplicationTypedConflictCodes(t *testing.T) {
	c := hybridHTTPConsequence()
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(c)
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		err    error
		status int
		code   string
	}{{domain.ErrHybridStale, 409, "HYBRID_STALE"}, {domain.ErrHybridIntentRequired, 409, "HYBRID_INTENT_REQUIRED"}, {domain.ErrHybridUnsafe, 409, "HYBRID_UNSAFE"}, {domain.ErrHybridConflict, 409, "HYBRID_CONFLICT"}, {domain.ErrHybridUnsupported, 422, "HYBRID_UNSUPPORTED"}, {errors.New("PRIVATE_DATABASE_CANARY"), 500, "HYBRID_UNAVAILABLE"}} {
		t.Run(tc.code, func(t *testing.T) {
			capture := &hybridApplicationCapture{err: tc.err}
			router := NewRouter(&Handler{HybridApplication: capture}, "general", "planner")
			req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/v1/students/"+c.StudentID+"/learning-paths/"+c.LearningPathID+"/hybrid-consequences", strings.NewReader(string(raw)))
			req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner")
			w := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(w, req)
			if w.Code != tc.status || !strings.Contains(w.Body.String(), tc.code) || strings.Contains(w.Body.String(), "PRIVATE_DATABASE_CANARY") {
				t.Fatalf("typederr status%d body%s", w.Code, w.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}
